title: Coherence and affine generators of inverse-image fan ideals
statement: Let V be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme, F a fine fan, c a LogFanChart V F [def-trf-fan-center-tensor-chart-data], and J a nonempty coherent fan ideal. The log ideal c.pullbackIdeal J is nonempty coherent. For every affine-center input D for c,J and every geometric point t with a lift w to D.U, its ideal stalk is exactly the set of products germ(D.chart p)*n, where p is in D.generators and n is an arbitrary log stalk element. No blowup is asserted.

proof.text: Fix $v\in V$ and $z=c(v)$. By [lem-trf-fan-chart-local-monoid-lift] there is a Zariski neighborhood of $v$ with a sharp fs chart $h:P\to N$, where $P=\mathcal P_{F,z}$, sharpening to $c$ on the affine open fan $F_z$. Coherence of $J$ gives finitely many generators on a neighborhood of $z$; restriction to the smallest neighborhood $F_z$ and its section/stalk identification in [lem-trf-fine-fan-point-localization] gives a finite nonempty $E\subset P$. Shrink the scheme neighborhood to an affine open. At every log stalk, an element lies above the characteristic ideal generated by $E$ exactly when its characteristic is $\overline{h(e)}+\bar n$ for some $e\in E$. Lift $\bar n$ to the log stalk; equality modulo units says the original element is $h(e)+n+u$ for a unit $u$. Thus the inverse-image ideal is exactly $(h(e):e\in E)N$. The same argument proves the asserted equality on any chart in the statement. These neighborhoods prove that $\mathcal I$ is nonempty coherent as defined in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup].

lean.statement: theorem fan_center_pullback_coherence (V : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}) (F : FineFan.Fan.{u}) (c : LogFanChart V F) (J : FineFan.IdealFamily F) (hJ : FineFan.IsNonemptyCoherentIdeal J) : V.logStructure.IsNonemptyCoherentIdeal (c.pullbackIdeal J) ∧ ∀ D : c.AffineCenterInput J, ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V.scheme) (w : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj ((logOpenEtale V.scheme).obj D.U)), V.logStructure.idealStalk (c.pullbackIdeal J) t = {m | ∃ p ∈ D.generators, ∃ n : V.logStructure.toEtalePrelogStructure.stalk t, V.logStructure.toEtalePrelogStructure.germ t ((logOpenEtale V.scheme).obj D.U) w (D.chart p) * n = m}
